text:
**No hiring choice can be put forward from this run:** the £400k annual-salary limit was not assessed, and salary effects were treated as unchanged for every option because their values are missing.

- The comparison is **very fragile**, with all inputs provisional and machine-authored; it also assumed that a higher platform-delivery score is better, rather than using a stated delivery objective.
- The result is especially contingent on annual salary spend, incremental delivery capacity, and onboarding load. This identifies model dependence, not which assumption matters most to investigate.
- To test the constraint, the model needs stated annual salary spend for each staffing option, and the £400k limit needs anchoring to the relevant salary measure.
